heading: Care for every stage of life
intro: From routine check-ups to pregnancy and screening, all with one doctor who knows your history.

items.name: Gynecology
items.summary: Care for women at every stage of life, from routine check-ups to complex gynecological conditions.
body: Dr. Gowthami offers complete gynecological care for women at every stage of life.
Care ranges from routine check-ups and preventive screening to the diagnosis and treatment of complex gynecological conditions.
Each visit starts with a conversation, so your treatment plan fits your health and your goals.

items.name: Obstetrics
items.summary: Pregnancy care from planning and conception through delivery and recovery.
body: Dr. Gowthami gives expert, caring support through every stage of pregnancy.
Care covers planning and conception, check-ups during pregnancy, delivery, and care after birth.
The aim is a safe, healthy pregnancy for both mother and baby.

items.name: Preventive Care
items.summary: Find health problems early and build healthy habits at every age.
body: Preventive care helps find health problems early, when they are easier to treat.
Dr. Gowthami also helps you build healthy habits and understand your body at every age.

items.name: Wellness Checks
items.summary: Personal check-ups focused on prevention, early detection and overall well-being.
body: A wellness check is not only for when something feels wrong.
These personal check-ups focus on prevention, early detection, and your overall well-being.

items.name: Cancer Screening
items.summary: Accessible, affordable and accurate screening for early detection and prevention.
body: Regular screening helps find cancer early, when treatment works best.
The clinic aims to make screening accessible, affordable, and accurate.
Ask Dr. Gowthami which screening tests suit your age and health history.
